nodes.author: MicroBerto
nodes.text:
Thanks. I won't ever know where the elevated ferritin came from, but I did everything possible to raise it:

- Iron fortified cereal for 20 years
- Heavy social drinking for 15 years
- High-dose D3 for 10 years
- Heavy red meat for 6 years

...and no blood donations for 25 years. So that's my most important target. I doubt it's just inflammation or infection, CRP and homocysteine are fine... I believe it's just straight up iron overload in the liver at this point.
